title: Orchestration Tool Registry
description: The definitive map of .py tools used for substrate maintenance, agent synchronization, and repository orchestration.

tools.name: verify_environment.py
tools.description: Validates the physical and structural baseline (venv, dependencies, checksums). Supports --maintenance flag.

tools.name: metagit_map.py
tools.description: Generates the internal DNS/mapping of all repositories. Optimized with differential caching.

tools.name: register_agent.py
tools.description: Anchors agent identity, Screen title, and Git config. Implements collision prevention locks.

tools.name: heartwood.py
tools.description: The official lens for legislative interpretation. Compiles JSON DNA into runtime reports.

tools.name: where_is.py
tools.description: Structured repository and context discovery tool. Queries the metarepo map by keyword.

tools.name: instantiate_hud.py
tools.description: Automates the migration of WeDo templates to the daily chrono-fractal RNA layer.

tools.name: context_prefetch.py
tools.description: Prepares recent logs and articles for successional context inheritance.

tools.name: metagit_commit.py
tools.description: Surgical commit wrapper ensuring strict identity attribution and forensic high-fidelity.

tools.name: metagit_pulse.py
tools.description: Monitors metabolic heat across the metarepo, identifying dirty repositories and divergent heads.

tools.name: harden_substrate.py
tools.description: Refines and stabilizes the filesystem structure based on Heartwood standards.
